findings.problem: The English translation gets the roles backwards: in the German, dir is the dative listener and meine Schwester is the accusative person being introduced, so the sister is introduced to you, not you to her.
findings.fix: example.en: I'll introduce my sister to you.

back.target: to introduce (a person); with sich: to imagine
back.example: I'll introduce my sister to you.

note: The hint "a person" keeps this card apart from einführen (to bring in a new product or system) and from the sich vorstellen card meaning "to imagine".
